title: 第148章 看不透的修为，元婴期大佬？
slug: 黄牛中介没想到你请得动真神啊
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

季伯渊压下心头的震动，目光重新落在张瑀身上。

这个从下界来的年轻修士，从踏入天符宗的那一刻起，就一直在刷新他的认知。

炼气十二层的修为，一剑破开筑基中期的三重护身罩，现在又轻描淡写地说能请来异界的阵法高人。

季伯渊修行数十年，见过太多惊才绝艳的人物。

但像张瑀这样的，他确实头一回遇到。

二长老站在一旁，嘴巴张了又合，合了又张。

他刚才还在问千机阵师的来历，现在张瑀给了他一个答案，他却觉得还不如不问。

不属于这一界。

这个答案比任何他不知道的名字都更让人震撼。

能让异界之人跨越界壁而来，这需要多大的能量？

要么是这位千机阵师自身的修为已经高到了可以无视界壁的程度，要么就是张瑀掌握着某种能沟通异界的特殊渠道。

无论哪一种，都意味着眼前这个年轻人的背景远比他表现出来的要深得多。

其他几位长老也面面相觑。

那位穿深绿色袍服的女长老压低声音对旁边的三长老说了句什么，三长老微微摇头，脸上的表情同样是难以置信。

大长老站在人群后方，脸色依然阴沉，但眼底深处闪过一丝不易察觉的忌惮。

他原本还在盘算着等这件事结束之后，要怎么替自己的徒弟找回场子。

但现在听到“不属于这一界”这几个字，他心里那股怒火不由得被浇了一瓢冷水。

一个能请动异界高人的修士，不是他能随便动的。

宁霜序站在张瑀身后，那双一向冷淡的眼睛里此刻满是复杂的光芒。

她看着张瑀的背影，嘴唇微微抿了一下，没有说话。

但她心里翻涌的波澜，比在场任何人都要剧烈。

从山道上那一剑开始，她就知道这个人不简单。

可现在她才发现，自己之前对“不简单”这个词的理解，还是太浅了。

直播间里的弹幕已经彻底炸了。

【不属于这一界？！主播这是要把千机阵师从地球拉到异界去吗！】

【跨界执法！这才是真正的跨界执法！之前主播在地球跨省办事我都不惊讶了，现在直接跨界！】

【天符宗的人全都傻了哈哈哈】

【宗主：我活了这么多年头一回见到这种操作】

【二长老的表情我能笑一年，刚才还在问人家是谁，现在知道答案了反而更懵了】

【主播这人脉也太硬核了，跨界请人，路费谁出？】

【路费肯定是天符宗出啊！主播是来办事的，又不是来旅游的！】

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Ji Boyuan suppressed the shock in his heart and looked at Zhang Yu again.

This young monk from the lower realm has been refreshing his knowledge from the moment he stepped into Tianfu Sect.

With a cultivation level of the twelfth level of Qi refining, he broke through the triple protective shield in the middle stage of foundation building with one sword, and now he said lightly that he could invite formation masters from other worlds.

Ji Boyuan has been practicing for decades and has seen many amazing and talented people.

But it was indeed his first time to meet someone like Zhang Yu.

The second elder stood aside, his mouth opening and closing, closing and opening again.

He was asking about the origins of the Qianji Formation Master just now, but now that Zhang Yu gave him an answer, he felt it was better not to ask.

Doesn't belong to this world.

The answer was more shocking than any name he didn't know.

How much energy does it take to allow people from other worlds to cross the boundary wall?

Either the Thousand Machine Formation Master's own cultivation level is high enough to ignore the boundary wall, or Zhang Yu has some special channel that can communicate with other worlds.

Either way, it means that the background of the young man in front of him is much deeper than what he shows.

Several other elders also looked at each other.

The female elder in dark green robes lowered her voice and said something to the third elder next to him. The third elder shook his head slightly, with the same expression of disbelief on his face.

The Great Elder stood behind the crowd, his face still gloomy, but there was a hint of unnoticeable fear deep in his eyes.

He was still thinking about how to regain his place for his apprentice after this incident was over.

But now that he heard the words "does not belong to this world", the anger in his heart could not help but be poured cold water on him.

A monk who can invite experts from other worlds is not something he can do casually.

Ning Shuangxu stood behind Zhang Yu, her eyes that were always cold were full of complex light at the moment.

She looked at Zhang Yu's back, pursed her lips slightly, and said nothing.

But the waves surging in her heart were more intense than anyone else present.

From that sword strike on the mountain path, she knew that this person was not simple.

But now she realized that her previous understanding of the word "not simple" was still too shallow.

The barrage in the live broadcast room has completely exploded.

【Don’t belong to this world?!Is the anchor trying to drag the Thousand Machine Array masters from the earth to another world?】

【Cross-border law enforcement!This is true cross-border law enforcement!In the past, I wasn’t surprised that anchors were working across provinces on Earth, but now they are directly crossing borders!】

[Everyone in Tianfu Sect is stupid hahaha]

[Sect Master: This is the first time I have seen this kind of operation in all my years]

[The expression of the second elder could make me laugh for a year. Just now I was asking who he was, but now I know the answer, I am even more confused]

[The anchor’s connections are too hard-core. If he hires someone from across the industry, who will pay for the travel expenses?】

[The travel expenses must be paid by Tianfu Sect!The anchor is here to do business, not to travel!】
